title: PackageInstallEventLog - Data API
description: PackageInstallEventLog stores details about package installation in the organization. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

ClientIp.description: The IP address of the client that’s using Salesforce services. A Salesforce internal IP (such as a login from AppExchange) is shown as “Salesforce.com IP”. For example: 96.43.144.26.

CpuTime.description: The CPU time in milliseconds used to complete the request. This field indicates the amount of activity taking place in the app server layer.

ErrorType.description: A general categorization of any error that’s encountered.

IsManaged.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsManaged.description: True if the operation is performed on a managed package. The default value is false.

IsPush.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsPush.description: True if the package was installed as a result of a push upgrade. The default value is false.

IsReleased.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsReleased.description: True if the operation is performed on a released package. The default value is false.

IsSuccessful.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsSuccessful.description: True if the package was successfully installed. The default value is false.

LoginKey.description: The string that ties together all events in a given user’s login session. It starts with a login event and ends with either a logout event or the user session expiring. For example: GeJCsym5eyvtEK2I.

OperationType.possible_values: INSTALL UPGRADE EXPORT UNINSTALL VALIDATE_PACKAGE INIT_EXPORT_PKG_CONTROLLER

PackageName.description: The name of the package that’s being installed.

RequestIdentifier.description: The unique ID of a single transaction. A transaction can contain one or more events. Each event in a given transaction has the same REQUEST_ID. For example: 3nWgxWbDKWWDIk0FKfF5DV.

RunTime.description: The amount of time that the request took in milliseconds.

SessionKey.description: The user’s unique session ID. You can use this value to identify all user events within a session. When a user logs out and logs in again, a new session is started. For example: d7DEq/ANa7nNZZVD.

Timestamp.description: The access time of Salesforce services in GMT. For example: 20130715233322.670.

Uri.description: The URI of the page that’s receiving the request. For example: /home/home.jsp.

UserIdentifier.description: The 18-character ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API. For example: 00530000009M943YAS

special_access_rules: To access this object, you must have the View Event Log Object Data user permission.
